d: We are seeking an experienced and qualified Obstetrician & Gynecologist to join a leading healthcare facility in Kuwait . The successful candidate will provide comprehensive obstetric and gynecological care, manage complex cases, and contribute to high-quality patient outcomes.
q: Medical degree with recognized postgraduate qualification in Obstetrics & Gynecology
Relevant post-specialization clinical experience at Specialist or Consultant level
Strong knowledge of modern obstetric and gynecological treatment protocols
Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
r: Diagnose and manage a wide range of obstetric and gynecological conditions
Provide antenatal, intrapartum, and postnatal care
Manage high-risk pregnancies and obstetric emergencies, where qualified
Perform gynecological examinations, procedures, and surgeries within the scope of practice
Provide comprehensive care for menstrual disorders, infertility, menopause, and other reproductive health concerns
Conduct prenatal counselling and patient education
Collaborate with maternal-fetal medicine specialists, neonatologists, surgeons, and other healthcare professionals
Maintain accurate medical records and ensure compliance with clinical protocols
Contribute to clinical education, quality improvement, and evidence-based practice
